subject: FINAL HANDOFF: Research Agent 04 — inner panel wake / presentation latency
body: HEAD=413d4a722fe8193f15ff086595f10d1464505ace. FINAL: Current WAKE_INNER_DISPLAY instrumentation stops when the hidden SurfaceControl POWER_MODE_NORMAL call returns through SurfaceFlinger/HWC; that is not proof that the Fold7 inner panel is logically STATE_ON, composed, or displaying a useful frame. Treat opening latency as separate fenced stages: semantic opening edge -> app scheduling -> Shizuku/shell -> physical power command -> logical route/state -> SurfaceFlinger composition -> actual presentation. Retain physical-only early prewake as a bounded Fold7 experiment because it can plausibly warm the inactive physical panel without forcing default-display ownership, but do not force logical routing/task migration merely to hide latency. Make first useful inner present the primary KPI. Current source also has WakeInner but no explicit SleepInner/revocation action, so early-reversal power cleanup is a mandatory physical-device test before promotion; do not add a blind OFF command that could fight Samsung. Reuse TransitionLab FrameTimeline and API35 transaction-completed/present-fence evidence. Measure DeviceState-edge vs 3-degree-only vs no-explicit-prewake A/B across slow/normal/fast opening and early reversals. If explicit prewake does not materially advance first present or causes ownership/power complexity, delete it. Peer reconciliation: Agent03 confirms physical/logical/presentation layering; Agent05 supplies present-fence path; Agent08 confirms DeviceState=edge and DisplayManager=route lifecycle only; Agent09 supports bounded prewake rather than permanent both-panels-on ownership. No production writes.
